about: settings-min-text: committed renames of line-baseline state keys in the committed fixture settings-min-text.lines.json (a supplement is recorded under the new keys and is not renamed). A baseline state that finds no head state fails unless this file renames it or lists it under retired. Each rule replaces a leading "from" with its "to" and applies, in order, to the key the rules before it produced. Retired states are named by their original fixture key. Row renames use exact tag-and-text keys in the remapped state. Row retirements apply only to the named cell and state. Neither rule changes the baseline line counts.
